svg.title: Лэндмайн-жим двумя руками — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. STANDING TWO-HANDED LANDMINE PRESS in side three-quarter view. One end of a LONG barbell is visibly anchored to a small pivot on FLOOR in FRONT of the person. At the other/free end are one or two WEIGHT PLATES near a short sleeve. BOTH hands cup that SAME free end close together. Left: hands and free end near upper chest, elbows bent. Right: both hands push free end FORWARD AND UP in a diagonal arc, elbows extend. Keep bar continuously connected to the SAME floor pivot; body upright and feet stable. NOT vertical overhead free bar, no second bar or kettlebell. Whole pivot and bar fit inside canvas. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
